title: fix: allow publishing community embeddings
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds an embedding-specific base price rule with input tokens only
- Stops the public-model form from requiring an unsupported completion-token price
- Adds a regression test for the publishing validation path

Fixes #14203

gist.headline: Embeddings may enter the garden
gist.blurb: Community embedding models can now be published without pretending they generate completion tokens. The form has learned that some endpoints simply listen very carefully.
gist.summary: Fixed community embedding publishing by adding an input-token-only base price rule and removing the public-model form's unsupported completion-token price requirement.
gist.impact: Community model publishers can now submit embedding endpoints with input-token pricing alone, so valid embedding models pass publishing validation.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully places a glowing embedding seed packet into a community model garden while a friendly CRT monitor robot checks an input-token-only price tag. Code-plants and small flowers show that the embedding endpoint is now accepted without a needless completion-token box.

A crossed-out empty completion-token form sits harmlessly nearby among flowers and code-plants; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
